from regression_support import *
t=Turn('CONT_SETUP');s=t.before
def named(name):return next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']==name)
f='Keep Edda’s protected innocence and withdraw my conflicting murderer request.'
oldfinding=s['36c107d0-448e-4ec8-8acf-0bbd1a80e624'];oldidea=s['f0f4d12b-e666-4d1c-9f86-271a75ea134c'];oldassert=s['a20b0b76-e180-44db-85ce-e5158bb4d186']
finding=t.revise(oldfinding,f);finding['disposition']='rejected_idea'
wi=t.revise(oldidea,f);wi['status']='rejected'
wa=t.revise(oldassert,f);wa['status']='rejected'
withdraw=t.decision('reject',f,[oldfinding,oldidea,oldassert],[finding,wi,wa],['Edda is the murderer.'],'Withdraw the conflicting murderer request while retaining Edda’s protected innocence.',[oldfinding,oldidea,oldassert])
for r in (finding,wi,wa):r['decision_ids'].append(withdraw['id'])
oldq=s['e82c4150-a3f3-41c6-8bea-8139ab892e51'];resolved=t.revise(oldq,f);resolved['state']='resolved'
qd=t.decision('resolve',f,[oldq],[resolved],[],'The current instruction resolves the earlier conflicting directions by keeping innocence and withdrawing the murderer request.',[oldq]);resolved['resolution_decision_id']=qd['id']
project=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='novel_project')
pr=records.revise_project(project,{'review_preferences':{'routine_checkpoint':'on_request'}},t.p);pr['source_refs']=[t.src('use on-request checkpoints.')];t.add(pr)
session=records.start_session(t.p,topic='Continuity review',mode='open');session['source_refs']=[t.src('Begin a Continuity review session in open mode')];t.add(session);t.p['session_id']=session['id']
def element(name,kind,fragment):
 r=t.base('story_element',fragment);r.update(element_type=kind,display_name=name,aliases=[],status='accepted',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=None,decision_ids=[]);return t.add(r)
def accepted_idea(statement,fragment,elements,assertions):
 i=t.idea(statement,fragment,elements,'accepted');i['resulting_assertion_ids']=[a['id'] for a in assertions];return i
def establish(fragment,parts,results,prior=None):
 action='revise' if prior else 'accept'
 d=t.decision(action,fragment,prior or results,results,parts,'Explicit current author-truth instruction, retaining unknown exact dates and unprovided causes.',prior)
 for r in results:
  if 'decision_ids' in r:r['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
 return d
runa=named('Rúna');edda=named('Edda');freyja=named('Freyja');sigrun=named('Sigrún')
f='Rúna arrives at the harbour after midnight'
oldharbour=named('Harbour');harbour=t.revise(oldharbour,f);harbour['status']='accepted'
arrival=element('Rúna harbour arrival','event',f);arrival['time_ref']=timing();arrival['time_ref']['chronology'].update(precision='partial',start='after midnight')
ar=t.assertion(runa,'arrives_at',ref(harbour),f,'accepted');ar['time_ref']=copy.deepcopy(arrival['time_ref']);arrival['assertion_ids']=[ar['id']];arrival['dependency_refs']=[ref(runa),ref(harbour)]
ai=accepted_idea('Rúna arrives at the harbour after midnight.',f,[runa,harbour,arrival],[ar]);establish(f,[ai['statement']],[harbour,arrival,ar,ai],[oldharbour])
f='Rúna learns the rescue code only after the ship sinks'
sinking=element('Ship sinking','event',f);sinking['time_ref']=timing()
learning=element('Rúna learns rescue code','event',f);learning['time_ref']=timing();learning['time_ref']['chronology'].update(precision='partial',after_refs=[ref(sinking)]);learning['dependency_refs']=[ref(runa),ref(sinking)]
learn=t.assertion(runa,'learns','rescue code only after the ship sinks',f,'accepted');learn['time_ref']=copy.deepcopy(learning['time_ref'])
knows=t.assertion(runa,'knows','rescue code',f,'accepted');knows.update(perspective='character_knowledge',holder_id=runa['id']);knows['time_ref']=copy.deepcopy(learning['time_ref'])
before=t.assertion(runa,'knows','rescue code',f,'accepted','denied');before.update(perspective='character_knowledge',holder_id=runa['id']);before['time_ref']['chronology'].update(precision='partial',before_refs=[ref(sinking)])
learning['assertion_ids']=[learn['id'],knows['id'],before['id']]
li=accepted_idea('Rúna learns the rescue code only after the ship sinks.',f,[runa,sinking,learning],[learn,knows,before]);establish(f,[li['statement']],[sinking,learning,learn,knows,before,li])
f='the planned escape requires the only usable boat'
oldboat=named('Possible boat');boat=t.revise(oldboat,f);boat.update(status='accepted',display_name='Only usable boat')
escape=element('Planned escape','plot_thread',f);escape['dependency_refs']=[ref(boat)]
requires=t.assertion(escape,'requires',ref(boat),f,'accepted');usable=t.assertion(boat,'usable_boat_scope','only usable boat',f,'accepted');escape['assertion_ids']=[requires['id']];boat['assertion_ids'].append(usable['id'])
ei=accepted_idea('The planned escape requires the only usable boat.',f,[escape,boat],[requires,usable]);establish(f,[ei['statement']],[boat,escape,requires,usable,ei],[oldboat])
f='no letter can cross the sealed boundary'
boundary=element('Sealed boundary','location',f)
rule=t.assertion(boundary,'letters_can_cross',False,f,'accepted');boundary['assertion_ids']=[rule['id']]
ri=accepted_idea('No letter can cross the sealed boundary.',f,[boundary],[rule]);establish(f,[ri['statement']],[boundary,rule,ri])
f='Freyja and Sigrún have never met before their reunion.'
reunion=element('Freyja and Sigrún reunion','event',f);reunion['dependency_refs']=[ref(freyja),ref(sigrun)];reunion['time_ref']=timing()
met=t.base('relationship',f);met.update(from_element_id=freyja['id'],to_element_id=sigrun['id'],meaning='have never met before their reunion',perspective='author_truth',holder_id=None,reader_audience=None,time_ref=timing(),status='accepted',decision_ids=[]);met['time_ref']['chronology'].update(precision='partial',before_refs=[ref(reunion)]);t.add(met)
mi=accepted_idea('Freyja and Sigrún have never met before their reunion.',f,[freyja,sigrun,reunion],[]);establish(f,[mi['statement']],[reunion,met,mi])
session['related_record_ids']=[r['id'] for r in t.rs if r['kind'] not in ('session','novel_project')]+[runa['id'],edda['id'],freyja['id'],sigrun['id']]
oath=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='relationship' and r['meaning']=='has sworn to protect')
reply=('Continuity review is now a separate open-ended session ('+cite(session)+'). Routine checkpoints are on request ('+cite(pr)+').\n\n'
       'Edda’s protected innocence remains in force. Your conflicting murderer request is withdrawn ('+cite(wi)+'; withdrawal decision '+cite(withdraw)+'); its significant conflict is closed as a rejected idea ('+cite(finding)+'), and the associated clarification is resolved ('+cite(resolved)+'; decision '+cite(qd)+'). Earlier versions remain inspectable.\n\n'
       'Established as author truths:\n\n'
       '- Rúna arrives at the harbour after midnight ('+cite(ai)+'; assertion '+cite(ar)+').\n'
       '- Rúna learns the rescue code only after the ship sinks ('+cite(li)+'; learning assertion '+cite(learn)+'; character-knowledge states '+cite(before)+' before sinking and '+cite(knows)+' after sinking).\n'
       '- The planned escape requires the only usable boat ('+cite(ei)+'; requirement '+cite(requires)+'; boat scope '+cite(usable)+').\n'
       '- No letter can cross the sealed boundary ('+cite(ri)+'; rule '+cite(rule)+').\n'
       '- Freyja and Sigrún have never met before their reunion ('+cite(mi)+'; relationship '+cite(met)+').\n\n'
       'Rúna’s established oath to protect Edda is preserved ('+cite(oath)+'). Exact dates and other unprovided timing remain unknown. The word “reunion” is retained as your event label without inventing an earlier meeting. No consequences or answers have been added. Paused here.')
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(oldfinding),ref(oldq),ref(oldboat),ref(oldharbour)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[finding['id']],'summary':'The current user withdraws the conflicting murderer request and preserves protected innocence; the sourced finding disposition and clarification resolution release only that prior hold. Reviewed the additional author truths against available canon. Unknown midnight-date relationships and boundary-crossing history are not inferred. Rescue-code knowledge is distinguished before and after the ship sinking; boat dependency and meeting chronology are recorded without invented consequences. Existing oath remains unchanged.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
